info.name: Hospital Management System (HMS) API
info.description:
End-to-end demo of every HMS service through the API Gateway.

HOW TO USE
1. Start the stack: docker compose up -d --build (wait until all containers are healthy).
2. Run the folders top to bottom, starting with '0. Setup' -> 'Start new demo run'. Or click Run collection to execute everything; each request has pass/fail tests.

Setup creates one user per role and stores each login token in its own variable (adminToken, doctorToken, ...), so every request is already sent as the right role. IDs created along the way (patientId, appointmentId, ...) are saved automatically. Re-running is safe: usernames get a fresh runId each time.

If you changed the bootstrap admin in .env, update the adminEmail / adminPassword collection variables.

item.name: 0. Setup - users & roles
item.description: Run first. Logs in the bootstrap admin and creates one user per role.

exec: const iso = x => x.getFullYear() + '-' + String(x.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0') + '-' + String(x.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
const now = new Date(); pm.collectionVariables.set('monthStart', iso(new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), 1)));
const later = new Date(); later.setDate(later.getDate() + 30); pm.collectionVariables.set('reportTo', iso(later));

request.description: Prepares this run: a unique suffix for usernames (so the collection can be re-run against the same database) and appointment/leave dates computed from today. Always run this first.
The first admin is created at startup from HMS_ADMIN_EMAIL / HMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD.
Security: nobody can make themselves an admin through public registration.
Only an existing admin can create another admin.
Security: every API except login/register needs a valid JWT.
